title: Bibliotheca
blurb: Photius of Constantinople, Bibliotheca (Myriobiblon) — Codices 1-17 in new English from Bekker 1824 Greek, from Theodore on Dionysius through the Acts of Ephesus and Chalcedon. Codices 18-279 are not in this volume.
first_english_note: Freese 1920 Vol. I (codices 1-165) is PD English; this is a new rendering from the Greek, not a claim of first-ever English.

text_history.method: New English from Bekker 1824 Greek as transcribed in the codex lock excerpts; Bekker loci cited per codex in the audit review; Hoeschel 1653 OCR as reading aid; Freese 1920 used reference-only.

author: Photius of Constantinople
era_note: Photius, Patriarch of Constantinople, compiled the Bibliotheca in the ninth century; these summaries describe Greek works many centuries older.
